about.title: Sobre mim
about.intro: Sou Engenheiro Frontend Sênior, moro em Belo Horizonte e tenho mais de 8 anos de experiência construindo aplicações web para empresas nos Estados Unidos, Europa e América Latina.
about.story: Me especializo em React e TypeScript, com foco forte em otimização de performance, design systems e arquitetura frontend. Já liderei migrações de frameworks legados, montei infraestruturas de teste do zero e mentorei engenheiros — sempre mantendo a mão na massa com entregas de features.
about.remote: Trabalho remotamente com times internacionais há anos e funciono muito bem em ambientes distribuídos e assíncronos. Me importo com qualidade, decisões técnicas bem pensadas e sistemas que escalam.
about.currentFocus: Atualmente estou explorando padrões avançados de React, workflows de desenvolvimento com IA e contribuindo com a comunidade frontend.

testimonial1.quote: Lucas is a very strong developer, that joined the team when it was forming, and very quickly provided lots of impact and results. His attention to execution and ideas were often not just praised by the team, but objectively valuable in generating better codebase and better functionalities. Particularly his drive in a huge frontend revamp played a fundamental role in meeting deadlines and even forecasting to stakeholders.
testimonial1.name: Fernando Aires

testimonial2.quote: I'm glad to recommend Lucas. He is an exceptional Frontend Developer and I've had a chance to work with him alongside. What sets Lucas apart is not just his technical prowess but also his outstanding communication skills and his willingness to assist teammates. He is proactive, taking the participation in team forming questions, takes the initiative, support teammates in challenging situations. In summary, Lucas is a highly skilled and dedicated developer and you will be fortunate enough to have him.
testimonial2.name: Marina Kulahina
